nom: Kopari Beauty Star Bright Vitamin C Discoloration Correcting Serum

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the serum brightens and addresses hyperpigmentation without making skin shiny or greasy, and one combination-oily reviewer found it non-irritating unlike other vitamin C serums.
segments.dry: No reviewer identifies as having dry skin specifically, though several mention hydration benefits.
segments.combination: A combination oily reviewer and a deep-brown combination-skin reviewer both report fading hyperpigmentation and smoother, clearer skin with regular use.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers report no irritation and note the serum faded melasma and brightened skin without triggering reactions, though one sensitive-skin user says she usually reacts to vitamin C products and is only cautiously optimistic so far.
segments.mature: A reviewer in her 50s with sun-damaged skin reports visible brightening and reduced blotchiness within two weeks.

concerns.aging: A reviewer with sun-damaged, mature skin reports brighter, less blotchy skin within two weeks of use.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers report the serum leaves skin feeling hydrated, plump, and smooth, with one noting improved skin barrier function; no reviewer reports dryness or dehydration worsening.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits the serum with strengthening her skin's natural barrier alongside improved hydration and complexion.
concerns.spots: The large majority of reviewers report fading of dark spots, hyperpigmentation, melasma, and sun spots, some within one to three weeks; two reviewers using it for 30 days to 3 months report no visible improvement in scarring or hyperpigmentation.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone or hormonal acne report the serum did not cause breakouts and helped with post-acne dark spots and scarring; one reviewer with heavy acne scarring saw no improvement after 30 days.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers describe the serum as non-greasy and absorbing without leaving shine, with one specifically praising it as the best vitamin C serum she has tried for oily skin.

aspects.libelle: Bursting beads seen as fun and effective

extraits.texte: I have a lot of acne scarring and hyperpigmentation on my face. I came across this product and after using it for 30 days, it did nothing for me. My scars are still visible, and I see no improvement.

I was looking for vitamin c serums to help fade my pregnancy melasma. I also wanted to try kakadu plum in a serum. Id never tried this brand before. Ive been using it every night for a few weeks now, and I definitely notice my melasma fading. It has a pleasant citrus scent. It hasnt irritated my sensitive skin. Its a bit pricey, but i will likely repurchase after i finish the bottle.

extraits.titre: Best Vitamin C for oily skin
extraits.texte: I have tried the vitamin C's from Natrurium and Clinique both did nothing for me. I was determined to get the glow and address my hyperpigmentation so off the recommendation of an Ulta employee, I purchased the Kopari vitamin C and I'm in love. The serum has small beads in there and it smells like oranges. It goes on well not sticky and immediately brightens my skin all day long and I have oily skin. It doesn't bleed into my eyes. It doesn't make me shiny yet it brightens up my skin and my sun spots on my forehead have faded dramatically. While I know something that works for me may not work for you. This is definitely worth a try! I am on my second bottle and will continue to use this. I love it so much.

Being in my 50's, with sun damaged skin.. this is the first serum I've used that actually works! Within two weeks, I noticed a difference! My skin was brighter, less blotchy looking. I'm very pleased with this product!

extraits.titre: The best vitamin C discoloration correcting serum
extraits.texte: I've been using this kopari for about 3 weeks, and I must say I love everything about it. Great for discoloration, smells good, and it doesn't break me out like other brands have. I am 10 months postpartum and my face is going through hormonal acne + I have oily skin, and this is definitely a life saver for my dark spots, although its a bit pricey but its a must have.

extraits.titre: The First Vit C Serum I can use with NO Irritation
extraits.texte: My skin is loving this serum, from the forst time I used it my skin just glows. Unlike the other high priced Vitamin C serums ive tried this did not irritate my sesative skin. Plus ots not sticky and has no smell which I appreciate. Plus the glass bottke do i can see whtn im running low. I only knew Kopari ftom the spf now I cannot wait to try the orher skincare. Highly Reccomend for Sensitive Skin

I use this serum in combination with the Star Bright Moisturizer and the Marine Clean gel cleanser. My skin has gotten clearer and smoother. All the hyperpigmentation spots are fading, and my complexion has started to glow! I have deep brown, combination skin. The serum and moisturizer have lasted for over two months and were used twice per day.
